question_variants: Average spend per customer by state
Which state's customers spend the most?
sql: SELECT u.state, AVG(oi.sale_price) AS avg_spend, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS customers FROM users u JOIN order_items oi ON u.id = oi.user_id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY u.state ORDER BY avg_spend DESC LIMIT 20
report: Average spend per customer by state, identifying geographic spending patterns.
